Title: A study + exam package
Text: I built SafePrep, a ServSafe Manager study app that tracks what a student knows and tells them when they're ready to test. You'd sell your exam with a SafePrep code included. They study on their own, and you proctor when they're ready. You're no longer "just the proctor." You're the person who got them certified.
Price: Your cost is $4.99 per student access code. You set your own package price and keep the difference.
Link: Reply and I'll send you a free code so you can try it yourself.

Title: A full online course for your students
Text: Our Student Presenter is a complete web-based ServSafe Manager course, along the same lines as ServSafe's own online course, which runs over $140. Because it's web-based, it updates automatically, and it's built for how today's students learn.
Price: $29.99 per student, or 3 for $79.99. Charge your students whatever your market will bear.
Link: Reply and I'll send you 7 days of free access.

Title: Thinking about becoming an instructor?
Text: If you'd like to pursue the instructor side, we'll guide you through the process, and our help is free. As an instructor, you can serve every student out there, including the ones who'd rather learn in a classroom.

If you haven't already, add your ServSafe certificate number to your listing. It's the number after CERTIFICATE NO. on your Instructor/Proctor certificate. Adding it is optional, but it puts a Verified badge on your listing so students know you're a certified proctor. The number itself is never shown.

Title: ⭐ Pro
Text: Everything in Preferred, plus students can pick a class and sign up right from your listing. You get an email with their info, and they get the class details, what to bring, and your payment link.
Price: Intro offer: $14.99 a month (normally $19.99), cancel anytime

Title: ⭐ Preferred
Text: The gold Preferred badge, a highlighted card that stands out from the list, and a top spot when students search near {place}. Plus post your full class schedule, up to 3 months out, instead of just the next 7 days.
Price: Intro offer: $7.99 a month (normally $9.99), cancel anytime

Title: ⭐ Pro Premium
Text: Your gold Preferred badge and top spot, students signing up for your classes right from your listing, plus your own page built to rank on Google for searches like "ServSafe classes {place}," with advanced class scheduling and a place to sell your packages and extras.
Price: Intro offer: $24.99 a month (normally $49.99), cancel anytime

Title: Free for your students
Text: SafePrep Refresher is a quick ServSafe review app for iPhone, free to share with your students. Scan the code, or tap the link.
